## Combo 1-396-1742-2232
Cards: Containment Construct + Skirge Familiar + Cloudstone Curio + Blessed Sanctuary
Color identity: WB | Bracket: 1+ (Exhibition) | Popularity: 1 | Commander: legal
Produces: Infinite creature tokens; Infinite creature ETB; Infinite creature LTB; Infinite self-discard triggers; Infinite storm count
Start: Containment Construct (battlefield); Skirge Familiar (battlefield); Cloudstone Curio (battlefield); Blessed Sanctuary (battlefield)
Prerequisites: You have a creature card in hand with mana value one or less that can be cast using black mana.
Steps: Activate Skirge Familiar by discarding a creature card with mana value one or less that can be cast using black mana, adding {B}.
  Containment Construct triggers, causing you to exile the creature card from your graveyard and allowing you to cast it from exile this turn.
  Cast the creature card from exile by paying its mana cost.
  The creature enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio and Blessed Sanctuary.
  Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing not to return anything to your hand from the battlefield.
  Resolve the Blessed Sanctuary trigger, creating a 2/2 Unicorn creature token.
  Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning the creature with mana value one or less from the battlefield to your hand.
  Repeat.

Color identity: WB | Bracket: 1+ (Exhibition) | Popularity: 0 | Commander: legal | Mana needed: {7}{W}{W}{W}{W}{W}
Produces: Near-infinite lifegain; Near-infinite lifeloss
Start: Peer into the Abyss (hand); Celestial Dawn (battlefield); Vizkopa Guildmage (battlefield); Martyr of Sands (battlefield)
Steps: Cast Peer into the Abyss by paying {4}{B}{B}{B}, causing you to draw half your library and lose half your life total, rounding up each time.
  Activate Vizkopa Guildmage by paying {1}{W}{B}, causing each opponent to lose life whenever you gain life this turn.
  Activate Martyr of Sands by paying {1}, revealing all white cards in your hand and sacrificing Martyr of Sands, causing you to gain 3 life for each card revealed this way.
  Vizkopa Guildmage triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to the amount of life you gained.
Notes: The pre-requisites state {W}{W}{W}{W}{W} because Celestial Dawn forces you to use white mana to pay for colored mana costs, as it turns all other colored mana into colorless. You must add the white mana and then use it when applicable as black mana.

## Combo 628-2292-6972
Cards: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight + Mikaeus, the Unhallowed + Viscera Seer
Color identity: WB | Bracket: 1+ (Exhibition) | Popularity: 2200 | Commander: legal
Produces: Infinite creature LTB; Infinite creature ETB; Infinite creature sacrifice triggers; Infinite death triggers; Infinite scry 1
Start: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight (battlefield); Mikaeus, the Unhallowed (battlefield); Viscera Seer (battlefield)
Prerequisites: You control another nontoken non-Human creature with base toughness 2 or greater.
Steps: Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing another nontoken non-Human creature
  When the creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
  Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
  When the creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
  Resolve the Viscera Seer abilities from step 1 and 3.
  Repeat.
Notes: If the creature being used starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

Requires: Persist Creature (battlefield)
Start: Mikaeus, the Unhallowed (battlefield); Warren Soultrader (battlefield); Moonlit Wake (battlefield)
Prerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
Steps: Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the persist creature.
  When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers if it didn't have a -1/-1 counter on it, and its undying ability triggers if it didn't have a +1/+1 counter on it. Moonlit Wake also triggers regardless.
  Resolve the Moonlit Wake trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
  Resolve the persist trigger, if applicable, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
  Resolve the undying trigger, if applicable, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
  Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
  Repeat

## Combo 628-2438-2781-3305
Cards: Body Launderer + Felidar Guardian + Mikaeus, the Unhallowed + Carrion Feeder
Color identity: WB | Bracket: 1+ (Exhibition) | Popularity: 11 | Commander: legal
Produces: Infinite card draw; Near-infinite mana permanents you control can produce; Infinite looting; Near-infinite +1/+1 counters on a creature; Infinite draw triggers; Near-infinite blinking of permanents; Near-infinite death triggers; Near-infinite creature ETB; Near-infinite creature LTB; Near-infinite creature sacrifice triggers
Start: Body Launderer (battlefield); Felidar Guardian (battlefield); Mikaeus, the Unhallowed (battlefield); Carrion Feeder (battlefield)
Prerequisites: Felidar Guardian does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Steps: Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Felidar Guardian.
  When Felidar Guardian dies, its undying ability and Body Launderer's first ability trigger.
  Resolve the Body Launderer trigger, causing it to connive.
  Resolve the Felidar Guardian trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
  When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Body Launderer.
  Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Felidar Guardian.
  When Felidar Guardian dies, Body Launderer's first ability triggers, causing it to connive.
  Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 6, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
  Resolve the Felidar Guardian trigger from step 5, blinking Body Launderer.
  Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 1, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
  Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Body Launderer.
  When Body Launderer dies, its undying and second ability triggers.
  Resolve the undying trigger,  returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
  Resolve the second Body Launderer trigger, returning Felidar Guardian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
  When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking any other permanent you control.
  Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 11, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
  Repeat.

Start: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight (battlefield); Mikaeus, the Unhallowed (battlefield); Yahenni, Undying Partisan (battlefield)

## Combo 670-1271-3991-4605-8194
Cards: Dack Fayden, Helping Hand + Preston, the Vanisher + Radiant Solar + Scroll Rack + Faceless Butcher
Color identity: WB | Bracket: 1+ (Exhibition) | Popularity: 0 | Commander: legal | Mana needed: {5}{W}{W}
Produces: Infinite card draw; Infinite ventures into the dungeon; Near-infinite Treasure tokens; Near-infinite colored mana; Near-infinite creature tokens; Near-infinite lifegain; Near-infinite lifeloss; Cast a subset of spells in your library; Near-infinite lifegain triggers; Near-infinite lifeloss for all players; Near-infinite +1/+1 counters on creatures you control; Infinite draw triggers; Near-infinite artifact ETB; Near-infinite creature ETB; Near-infinite creature LTB; Near-infinite creature sacrifice triggers; Near-infinite draw triggers; Near-infinite self-discard triggers
Start: Dack Fayden, Helping Hand (hand); Preston, the Vanisher (hand); Radiant Solar (hand); Scroll Rack (battlefield); Faceless Butcher (hand)
Steps: Activate Scroll Rack by paying {1} and tapping it, exchanging as many cards as you choose from your hand with an equal number from the top of your library, ensuring Radiant Solar, Preston the Vanisher, and Faceless Butcher will be the creatures encountered by Dack. (Note: if those three are the only creature cards in your library, most likely due to deck construction, you may omit this step.)
  Cast Dack Fayden by paying {4}{W}{W}.
  When Dack enters, its ETB triggers, putting the three creatures mentioned into play and giving one to each opponent.
  Faceless Butcher triggers once, Preston triggers twice, and Radiant Solar triggers three times. Choose Preston as the target for Faceless Butcher.
  Resolve Faceless Butcher's trigger, exiling the Preston you gave away until Faceless Butcher leaves the battlefield.
  Resolve a Preston trigger, creating an Illusion copy of Faceless Butcher.
  The Illusion Faceless Butcher triggers, exiling the original and returning Preston to the battlefield under your control.
  Resolve a Preston trigger, creating an Illusion copy of Radiant Solar. It triggers, giving you a fourth "venture into the dungeon" trigger.
  Resolve three venture triggers, progressing through the Tomb of Annihilation until you reach the Sandfall Cell and losing 3 life in the process (reduced to 1 if you have a card available to discard).
  Sacrifice the Illusion Faceless Butcher to the Sandfall Cell, returning the original Faceless Butcher to the battlefield.
  Faceless Butcher, Preston, and each Radiant Solar you control all trigger.
  Resolve Faceless Butcher's trigger, exiling the nontoken Radiant Solar until it leaves the battlefield.
  Resolve Preston's trigger, creating an Illusion copy of Faceless Butcher.
  The Illusion Faceless Butcher triggers, exiling the original and returning Radiant Solar to the battlefield.
  Preston, the nontoken Radiant Solar, and each Illusion copy of Radiant Solar all trigger.
  Resolve a Preston trigger, creating an additional Illusion copy of Radiant Solar.
  The Illusion of Radiant Solar triggers, giving you an additional "venture into the dungeon" trigger.
  Resolve four venture triggers, completing and re-entering the Tomb of Annihilation. Progress to the Sandfall Cell, losing 3 life in the process (reduced to 1 if you have a card available to discard).
  Repeat steps 10 through 18. Now that you have more than one token copy of Radiant Solar, each iteration will result in an increasing number of venture triggers in excess of the four needed to perform the loop. 
  For each group of four excess venture triggers, you may alternate between the Tomb of Annihilation and the Lost Mine of Phandelver. Due to the Veils of Fear room and the Dark Pool room, this will offset the life loss and discard from the Tomb while accelerating your opponents' life loss.

  The Illusion Faceless Butcher triggers, exiling the original and returning Preston to the battlefield under your control.
  Resolve a Preston trigger, creating an Illusion copy of Radiant Solar. It triggers, giving you a fourth "venture into the dungeon" trigger.
  Resolve three venture triggers, progressing through the Tomb of Annihilation until you reach the Sandfall Cell and losing 3 life in the process (reduced to 1 if you have a card available to discard).
  Sacrifice the Illusion Faceless Butcher to the Sandfall Cell, returning the original Faceless Butcher to the battlefield.
  Faceless Butcher, Preston, and each Radiant Solar you control all trigger.
  Resolve Faceless Butcher's trigger, exiling the nontoken Radiant Solar until it leaves the battlefield.
  Resolve Preston's trigger, creating an Illusion copy of Faceless Butcher.
  The Illusion Faceless Butcher triggers, exiling the original and returning Radiant Solar to the battlefield.

  Resolve a Preston trigger, creating an additional Illusion copy of Radiant Solar.
  The Illusion of Radiant Solar triggers, giving you an additional "venture into the dungeon" trigger.
  Resolve four venture triggers, completing and re-entering the Tomb of Annihilation. Progress to the Sandfall Cell, losing 3 life in the process (reduced to 1 if you have a card available to discard).
  Repeat steps 10 through 18. Now that you have more than one token copy of Radiant Solar, each iteration will result in an increasing number of venture triggers in excess of the four needed to perform the loop. 
  For each group of four excess venture triggers, you may alternate between the Tomb of Annihilation and the Lost Mine of Phandelver. Due to the Veils of Fear room and the Dark Pool room, this will offset the life loss and discard from the Tomb while accelerating your opponents' life loss.
